description: Failure and edge scenarios for lab 18. Each id is implemented by the SDK example; the expected status and the text the server's detail must contain come from here.

scenarios.title: The primary owner cannot be removed
The primary owner cannot be demoted
An editor cannot promote themselves to owner
A reviewer cannot add a member
An owner cannot grant owner to someone without both platform scopes
An unknown project role is rejected
scenarios.detail_contains: role must be owner, editor, reviewer, or viewer

scenarios.title: A token cannot be issued with a scope its owner lacks
scenarios.detail_contains: cannot grant scopes you do not hold

scenarios.title: A non-member cannot bind a token to the project
A viewer-scoped token cannot write even for an owner
A bound token is refused for another project
scenarios.request: priya's token bound to the support project, X-CALIBER-Project: <billing project>

scenarios.title: An expired token stops authenticating
scenarios.request: GET /projects with a token whose expires_at has passed

scenarios.title: A wrong password does not sign in
Only an admin can read the audit log
A write without the CSRF header is refused when CSRF is enabled
scenarios.request: maya POST /projects/{id}/members without X-CALIBER-CSRF (only when GET /csrf says enabled)
